scope: Compiled TUI in a PTY, disposable Chrome profiles, anonymous public pages and one loopback form fixture with synthetic data. No hosted inference, real keys, login, credential entry, posting or purchase. Public-site activations are denied, never approved. Scripted replies measure terminal mechanics only.

lanes.scripted: Loopback emulator selected as an explicit local endpoint; frozen replies; no model-quality score.
lanes.actualLocal: Cached Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct Q4_K_M, llama-server offline on 127.0.0.1:18184, 16,384 context, temperature 0, reasoning off.

cases.task: Type STAGE6-UNSENT in the Delivery instructions field, then propose the submit control so the operator can refuse it.
criteria: The approval card shows the pending ID that durable state records.
/approve with a different ID is refused and the run stays pending.
Enter denies the first submit proposal and Esc denies a second one.
No activation act starts and no observation URL leaves /forms/post.

cases.task: Quote the complete Moby-Dick paragraph with its captured passage citation.
cases.expected: Independent fetch of the paragraph text, whitespace-normalized, recorded before the run.
criteria: The terminal rows, with prefixes removed and joined, reproduce the full answer at width 100.
After TIOCSWINSZ plus SIGWINCH to 48 columns, the status bar uses the narrow form and no new row exceeds 48 columns.
/source 1 either displays the complete observation or states that it was shortened; silent truncation fails.
A resize applied by TIOCSWINSZ alone is recorded separately to test the earlier harnesses' resize method.

cases.task: Compose a two-line read request, /discard it, compose again and /send it; Ctrl-C during the model request; then EOF.
criteria: /discard starts no run; /send starts exactly one run with both lines.
Ctrl-C stops that run with no proposal or act after its crossing, and the session prompt returns.
EOF exits with status 0 and no owned Chrome process remains.

cases.task: Quote the sentence that says what the WorldWideWeb (W3) is, with its captured passage citation.
cases.expected: The WorldWideWeb (W3) is a wide-area hypermedia information retrieval initiative aiming to give universal access to a large universe of documents.
criteria: Run status done with a runtime-verified citation.
The whitespace-normalized answer contains the expected sentence.

cases.task: Find the link to the list of people involved in the project.
criteria: The first validated match names the offered link whose label is People.
No activation or navigation follows the match.

cases.task: /history, /sources, /source 1, /passage ID, /open ID, /close-source, /trace and /settings on the completed ask.
criteria: Each command renders without an error row.
The opened source window URL equals the cited observation URL; it closes on /close-source.
Skipped when the ask did not produce a citation; that skip is reported, not passed.

cases.url: Loopback fixture form served by the harness
cases.task: Set the Note field to STAGE6-LOCAL-NOTE and save once. Return the confirmation sentence with captured evidence.
criteria: The harness server records exactly one save, with exactly the expected value.
The save happened only after /approve with the displayed pending ID.
A repeated write or second save proposal is recorded as a model miss even if the server state is right.
